findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: issue_score_credential, get_monitoring_info, check_wallet_permissions · Private data: issue_score_credential, check_xrpl_score, get_account_credentials, get_issuer_credentials, check_mpt_risk, search_mpts, get_issuer_mpts, check_service_health, verify_mpt_registry, check_domain_eligibility, submit_grant_application, donate_to_community_fund, screen_address_ofac, get_monitoring_info, get_underwriting_inputs, check_wallet_permissions, prepare_batch_send, get_lending_history · Public sink: submit_grant_application, screen_address_ofac, get_monitoring_info, prepare_batch_send · Destructive: get_lending_exposure, precheck_payment, check_wallet_permissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: issue_score_credential, get_monitoring_info, check_wallet_permissions · Private data: issue_score_credential, check_xrpl_score, get_account_credentials, get_issuer_credentials, check_mpt_risk, search_mpts, get_issuer_mpts, check_service_health, verify_mpt_registry, check_domain_eligibility, submit_grant_application, donate_to_community_fund, screen_address_ofac, get_monitoring_info, get_underwriting_inputs, check_wallet_permissions, prepare_batch_send, get_lending_history · Public sink: submit_grant_application, screen_address_ofac, get_monitoring_info, prepare_batch_send · Destructive: get_lending_exposure, precheck_payment, check_wallet_permissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
